newsitem.title: USA: HealthCor to buy United Medical assets.
newsitem.headline: HealthCor to buy United Medical assets.

text.p: HealthCor Holdings Inc said on Sunday it has entered into a letter of intent to purchase substantially all of the assets of United Medical Inc.

United Medical, based in Wynne, Arkansas, provides home medical equipment, home respiratory services and home infusion services through 20 locations, generating $18.7 million in revenues for year ended September 30, 1996, HealthCor said.
HealthCor said it plans to complete negotiations and its due diligence review during December and anticipates the transaction closing in early January.
The purchase price was not immediately available.
